sections.title: Teaching Second Language Literacy
sections.description:
This course explores methods of developing instructional experiences that support and promote the acquisition of literacy in a second language. This course focuses on bringing together literacy theory and practice to engage students in unpacking what is meant by literacy and how to plan for literacy instruction in ways that are responsive to the needs of children, adolescents and adults learning English as a second language. There are a number of objectives:
•	To be able to identify, describe, and apply different literacy theories.
•	To be able to read, analyze, critique, and respond to selected literature and actual practices in the field of second language literacy.
•	To create literacy experiences that are responsive to the needs of second language learners.
•	To explore issues of language, culture, and power currently impacting second language literacy instruction.
